disputed: Supporters (for example the Institute for Energy Research and American Energy Alliance) argue the provisions restore pre-IRA royalty rates and leasing certainty, increase domestic supply, and lower energy costs. Several provisions, such as the 45Q carbon-capture credit expansion, are also backed by some Democrats. Cost estimates depend on assumptions about future prices and production.

items: Onshore oil and gas royalties cut from 16.7% to 12.5%. Offshore royalties cut to 12.5-16.7% (from 16.67-18.75%). Federal coal royalties capped at 7% for 10 years (from a 12.5% minimum). Estimated cost: about $6 billion over FY2025-2034. (Taxpayers for Common Sense (https://www.taxpayer.net/energy-natural-resources/oil-gas-coal-win-big-in-the-one-big-beautiful-bill/))

Mandated lease sales: 30 in the Gulf by 2040, six in Cook Inlet, five in the National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska, and four in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. Interior must offer at least 50% of nominated onshore parcels and open 4 million more acres to coal leasing. (Taxpayers for Common Sense (https://www.taxpayer.net/energy-natural-resources/oil-gas-coal-win-big-in-the-one-big-beautiful-bill/); BLM IM 2026-018 (https://www.blm.gov/policy/im-2026-018))

The Inflation Reduction Act's methane fee, projected to raise $7.2 billion over a decade, was delayed. (Taxpayers for Common Sense (https://www.taxpayer.net/energy-natural-resources/oil-gas-coal-win-big-in-the-one-big-beautiful-bill/))

The Brennan Center estimates about $18 billion in tax incentives for oil and gas firms in the law. (Brennan Center (https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/fossil-fuel-industry-donors-see-major-returns-trumps-policies))
sections.label: Documentation

summary: The July 2025 reconciliation law (Pub. L. 119-21) cut the royalties oil, gas and coal companies pay on public land, required large numbers of lease sales (including the Arctic Refuge), delayed the methane fee, and expanded fossil-fuel tax breaks, while phasing out many clean-energy credits.
title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act: royalty cuts, mandated lease sales, and a delayed methane fee
